CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SimpleTexting_Warmup_Release_Log" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ghl_contact_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  contact_email TEXT,
  contact_phone TEXT,
  contact_timezone TEXT,
  week_number INT,
  release_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  release_ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  run_id TEXT,
  campaign_key TEXT,
  template_key TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS simpletexting_warmup_release_log_idx_date ON "SimpleTexting_Warmup_Release_Log" (release_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS simpletexting_warmup_release_log_idx_ts ON "SimpleTexting_Warmup_Release_Log" (release_ts DESC);

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN release_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::int AS sent_today,
  ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id), NULL) AS released_contact_ids
FROM "SimpleTexting_Warmup_Release_Log";

parameters.content:
LT - SimpleTexting Warmup Dispatcher (Staged)

Purpose
- Release only new contacts into SimpleTexting first-touch SMS sends.
- Enforce local-time weekday gating and 5/10/15 daily ramp.
- Keep send logging separate in Postgres so each contact only counts once.
- Apply sequence entry tags on first successful release.

Current safety defaults
- inactive workflow
- defaultDryRun = true
- ghlSearchBodyJson is blank on purpose

Config still needed before activation
- define ghlSearchBodyJson with the exact GHL contact filter body
- set rampStartDate or warmupWeekOverride
- confirm defaultTemplateKey for first-touch send

Current gate assumptions
- Monday-Friday only
- contact local hour >= 10 and < 16
- week 1 = 10/day, week 2 = 15/day, week 3+ = 20/day
- skip contacts already tagged simpletext_stop / simpletext_finished / simpletext_ongoing
